You'll play a key role in educating the industry, strengthening customer relationships, and supporting the continued growth of one of the most respected brands in HVAC/R. For more than 30 years, Fieldpiece has been dedicated to delivering rugged, innovative tools specifically for HVACR professionals. Our products help technicians work smarter, troubleshoot faster, and perform at their best every day. Fieldpiece is a US-based, family-owned business with European offices in the Netherlands and England. We’ve been in Europe since 2020 and have an excellent opportunity to continue to expand. As one of the Best Places to Work in Southern California (2023, 2024, 2025, & 2026) , we’re proud of our people-first culture and Hire to Retire philosophy and bring that to all our offices. Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, and Technical Support teams to ensure training programs align with business objectives. Ability to build trusted relationships with customers, distributors, and industry stakeholders. Strong organizational and project management skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and presentation software. Fluent English and German. Valid driver's license and willingness to travel approximately 50%. Preferred Experience Experience working with distributors, manufacturers, technical schools, or training organizations. Experience delivering hands-on product demonstrations and application-based training. Familiarity with adult learning principles and instructional design. Experience creating digital, video, or online learning content. What We Offer Competitive salary and annual bonus. Company vehicle or car allowance. Opportunity to represent a market-leading HVAC/R brand. Remote working flexibility. Career growth opportunities within a global organization. Ongoing professional development and training. review_candidates.description: Company Description R-DATS Consulting LTD is a research, evaluation, data collection, statistical services, and opinion polls firm that generates high-quality data and evidence to inform impactful policies and programs. The organization applies advanced and innovative methods and adheres strictly to ethical principles and data privacy standards in all countries where it operates. Its multidisciplinary team has extensive experience with large-scale mixed-method research, household surveys such as DHS and MICS, and complex data analysis. R-DATS supports local and international organizations, government ministries and agencies, businesses, and non-profits across Africa in sectors including health, nutrition, agriculture and food security, WASH, education, social protection, gender, migration, peace and conflict, green energy, land governance, and financial inclusion. Role Description The Survey Field Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing field data collection activities across multiple projects. This full-time remote role includes managing field teams, developing fieldwork plans, supervising survey implementation, and ensuring adherence to ethical and data quality standards. Day-to-day tasks involve coordinating logistics with in-country offices, monitoring field progress, troubleshooting operational challenges, and providing regular status updates to project leads and clients. The Survey Field Manager will support training of enumerators and supervisors, review and validate incoming data, and collaborate with research and data analysis teams to ensure that field operations align with project objectives. The role also involves contributing to survey tools development, documenting lessons learned, and promoting continuous improvement in field procedures. Candidates should possess skills in data quality assurance, including monitoring, validation checks, and adherence to ethical and data privacy standards. Candidates should possess skills in stakeholder communication, including clear reporting to project teams, clients, and local partners. Candidates should possess skills in using digital data collection tools and basic data management software. Relevant experience with large-scale surveys, mixed-method research, or work in sectors such as health, agriculture, WASH, education, or social protection is beneficial. A bachelor’s degree or higher in social sciences, statistics, public health, economics, or a related field is preferred. Demonstrated ability to work remotely across different time zones, with cultural sensitivity and strong problem-solving
